transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, what brings me in is that... I keep arranging my own house around not seeing spiders. 

It's gotten to the point where I put off doing the laundry just because it's down in the basement. I completely avoid the garden shed. I'm even paying people to come do small jobs around the house that I know perfectly well how to do myself, just because I can't make myself go into those spaces. I just can't do it.
Can you describe what happens when you encounter a spider or even think about seeing one? How does it make you feel physically and emotionally?

Well, if I actually spot one, the reaction is pretty immediate. My chest tightens up right away, and my hands start to shake. I usually either just freeze right there in the doorway, or... or I back out so fast. It's honestly like my body has decided to get out of there before I can even think about it.
How long has this fear of spiders been affecting you, and has it ever gotten to the point where you felt it was interfering with your daily life or responsibilities?

It's been about thirteen months now. It started shortly after I moved into this house... I was unpacking some boxes and ended up finding those spiders, and it's just been an issue ever since. 

And as far as interfering with my daily life, yes, absolutely. Like I mentioned, I can't even do my own laundry or basic chores without having to plan around it or hire someone else to do it. It's definitely getting in the way of my normal responsibilities.
Do you find yourself avoiding places or situations where you think spiders might be, even if you don't actually see one right then?

Yes, I do. I mean, I kind of mentioned that already with the basement and the shed. I don't have to see a spider to stay away from those places. I just know they're probably down there, or out there, so I just don't go. I'll let the laundry pile up for a week just to avoid the basement, even if I haven't seen a spider there in months. It's just the thought that one *might* be there that keeps me away.
When you think about encountering a spider, do you ever experience sudden feelings of intense fear or panic, like something bad is about to happen?

Yes, I do. I mean, logically, I know a spider sitting in the corner of an old house probably isn’t going to actually hurt me. But... the moment I even just picture one dropping out of a box, or sitting down there near the washer, that panic just hits. It suddenly feels enormous and... threatening, in a way that I'm honestly pretty embarrassed to admit.

Do you ever feel anxious or panicky even when you're just thinking about the possibility of encountering a spider in the future, like hours or days before you might have to go into the basement or shed?

No, I don't really get panicky hours or days ahead of time. I mean, I know I'm avoiding the basement, so I just... don't think about going down there. The anxiety really only hits when I'm actually faced with the prospect of having to go near those spaces, or if I'm actively imagining one in that moment. But I don't sit around worrying about it days in advance. I just avoid the situation entirely.
